rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# libtoolize must not run, it would replace the files of these sources with # those of the installed libtool. LIBTOOLIZE="true" autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
# The script libtool has the names of the programs in it, without a folder # they are looked for in the path. With --enable-cxx-stdlib it lets g++ find # its own libraries and object files, Debian edits the script to that end. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --enable-cxx-stdlib \ GREP="grep" \ SED="sed" \ LD="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-ld" \ NM="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-nm -B" \ ac_cv_path_lt_DD="dd"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
LIBTOOL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/libtool"
sed -i "s@-ffile-prefix-map=[^ \"']* *@@g" \ "$LIBTOOL"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then # Nothing of the compiler that built this, which is the one of the tools # folder. sed -i 's@^sys_lib_search_path_spec=.*@sys_lib_search_path_spec="/lib /usr/lib"@' \ "$LIBTOOL"
# As in Debian, libtool knows the compilers by their short names, with tags # of their own. Debian's tag for C only has the names of the compiler, but # libtool goes through the tags in order and what the one before has set # stays. No library was linked, and nothing said so. for PROG in gcc cc; do TAG="BIN`echo $PROG | tr a-z A-Z`"
echo sed -n '/^# ### BEGIN LIBTOOL CONFIG$/,/^# ### END LIBTOOL CONFIG$/p' "$LIBTOOL" | \ sed -e "s/LIBTOOL CONFIG/LIBTOOL TAG CONFIG: $TAG/" \ -e "s/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc/$PROG/g" done > "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/tags"
for PROG in g++ c++; do TAG="BIN`echo $PROG | tr a-z+ A-ZX`"
echo sed -n '/^# ### BEGIN LIBTOOL TAG CONFIG: CXX$/,/^# ### END LIBTOOL TAG CONFIG: CXX$/p' "$LIBTOOL" | \ sed -e "s/CONFIG: CXX/CONFIG: $TAG/" \ -e "s/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-g++/$PROG/g" done >> "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/tags"
cat "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/tags" >> "$LIBTOOL"
sed -i "s/^available_tags='\(.*[^ ]\) *'/available_tags='\1 BINGCC BINCC BINGXX BINCXX'/" \ "$LIBTOOL" fi
